series_start_reason: First quarter printed: Q1 2010 is the first column of table 13 (Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division quarterly product sales) of the Q1 2011 Roche media release; no earlier Roche quarterly figure was found (2009 and 2010 results releases could not be retrieved, and the Half-Year Report 2010 prints six-month totals only).
notes: Printed line is "Herceptin" in the worldwide Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division table of each Roche release; the line is a single brand line and the table does not state which formulations it contains. The United States table that follows it in each release is a separate table and is not used. launch_quarter is left null because no launch quarter was looked up in Roche documents. moa_class her2_antibody is new: no existing class in seed/product_attributes.csv covers an unconjugated HER2 antibody.
search_log: reused the crawl in work/events.json of roche.com/investors/events/{q1,hy,q3,annual-results}-YYYY (2016-2026) and downloaded every Investor update PDF it links (work/pdf), plus assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf releases for 2011-2015 and the 2016-2017 investor updates

probed assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf (HTTP HEAD, then fetched) for weekdays in 20 Jan-15 Feb and 10-31 Jul of 2009-2015, 8-25 Apr and 10-25 Oct of 2009, 2010 and 2014, and 10-25 Oct 2014; this found the results releases dated 2011-02-02, 2011-07-21, 2012-02-01, 2012-07-26, 2013-01-30, 2014-07-24, 2014-10-16 and 2015-07-23, which print year-to-date product tables only (no five-quarter table); no 2009 or 2010 release was found

tried www.roche.com/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf, www.roche.com/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DDe.pdf, assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DDe.pdf and www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD.htm for weekdays in late Jan-12 Feb, 15-30 Apr, 15-30 Jul and 10-28 Oct 2010: none answered
read the Roche Half-Year Report 2010 (assets.cwp.roche.com/f/126832/f796568dac/hy10e.pdf): it prints six-month product sales only, no quarterly columns

parsed the worldwide "Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division quarterly product sales" table (five quarterly columns; the United States, Europe, Japan and International tables that follow it are separate) of every release retrieved; a quarter is taken from the column of the release that reports it as current, else the Q1 three-month key-products table, else the earliest later release that prints it
series starts at 2010Q1 because the Q1 2011 media release (13 April 2011) prints five quarterly columns Q1 2010 to Q1 2011 and no retrieved Roche document prints an earlier quarter

cross-checked every quarter against every other release that prints it: no differing value found; the four quarters of each year equal the full-year figure printed in that year's results release wherever a full-year row for the product exists
